billing.InvoiceRecord.description: Detailed invoice information including payment details and status

amount.description:
Total amount due for the invoice
required: true
example: 1500.50
minimum: 0

currency.description:
Currency code for the invoice amount
required: true
example: USD
pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$

dueDate.description:
Date when the invoice payment is due
required: true
example: 2024-12-01T00:00:00Z
format: date-time

id.description:
Unique identifier for the invoice
required: true
example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
format: uuid

invoiceStatus.description:
Current status of the invoice
required: true
example: PAID
enum: DRAFT,PENDING,PAID,OVERDUE,CANCELLED,VOID

number.description:
Invoice number or reference
required: true
example: INV-2024-001
minLength: 1

paymentLink.description:
URL where the invoice can be paid
required: false
example: https://payment.example.com/inv/12345
format: uri

publicUrl.description:
Public URL to access the invoice PDF
required: false
example: https://invoices.example.com/12345.pdf
format: uri

status.description: Status indicates the result of the operation ("success" or "error")

restenrich.EnrichOrganizationData.description: Detailed enriched information about an organization

Brief description of the organization
required: false
example: A global leader in innovative solutions

domain.description:
Organization's primary domain
required: true
example: acme.com

employees.description:
Number of employees
required: false
minimum: 0
example: 5000

foundedYear.description:
Year the organization was founded
required: false
minimum: 1800
maximum: 2100
example: 1995

icons.description:
URLs to organization icons
required: false
example: ["https://acme.com/icon.png"]

logos.description:
URLs to organization logos
required: false
example: ["https://acme.com/logo.png"]

longDescription.description:
Detailed description of the organization
required: false
example: Acme Corporation provides cutting-edge technology solutions across the globe

Organization name

public.description:
Indicates if the organization is publicly traded

example: true

socials.description:
Social media presence
required: false
example: ["https://linkedin.com/company/acme"]

website.description:
Organization's website URL
required: true
example: https://acme.com
format: uri

industry.description:
Primary industry category
required: true
example: Technology

domain.description:

expiredDate.description:
Domain expiration date
required: true

example: 2025-09-14

nameservers.description:
List of assigned nameservers
required: true
minItems: 2
example: ["ns1.example.com","ns2.example.com"]

restoutreach.EmailTrackingRequest.description: Request payload for generating email tracking URLs and pixels

campaignId.description:
Unique identifier for the email campaign
required: true
example: camp_123456

generateUnsubscribeLink.description:
Enable unsubscribe link generation
required: false
default: false

links.description:
List of URLs to be tracked
required: false
example: ["https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2"]

messageId.description:
Unique identifier for the message (optional, generated if not provided)
required: false
example: msg_123456

recipientId.description:
Unique identifier for the recipient
required: true
example: recipient_123456

trackClicks.description:
Enable click tracking for links
required: false
default: false

trackOpens.description:
Enable open tracking via pixel
required: false
default: false

trackerDomain.description:
Domain to use for tracking URLs (optional, system default used if not provided)
required: false
format: hostname
example: track.example.com

unsubscribeLink.description:
URL for unsubscribe page
required: false
format: uri
example: https://example.com/unsubscribe

restoutreach.EmailTrackingResponse.description: Response containing generated tracking URLs and pixel

status.description:
Operation status
required: true
enum: success

trackedLinks.description:
List of original and tracked URLs (only if TrackClicks is true)
required: false

trackingId.description:
Generated or provided message ID
required: true

trackingPixel.description:
URL for tracking pixel (only if TrackOpens is true)
required: false
format: uri

unsubscribeLink.description:
Generated unsubscribe link (only if GenerateUnsubscribeLink is true)
required: false
format: uri

restoutreach.TrackedLink.description: Pair of original and tracking-enabled URLs

original.description:
Original URL before tracking
required: true
format: uri

tracked.description:
Generated tracking URL
required: true
format: uri
